summary: Iteration 8 — tested new Reviews/Portfolios/VendorProfile module end-to-end. Added /app/backend/tests/test_reviews.py (13 tests, all pass). Full regression: 141 passed, 1 pre-existing skip. Backend verified: GET /api/portfolios/filters returns cities [Bandung,Bekasi,Jakarta,Jepara] + 8 work_types; GET /api/portfolios returns city/work_types/rating_avg/review_count; filters ?city=Bandung and ?work_type=kitchen_set correctly scope results; ?sort=rating returns strictly desc avg. GET /api/vendors/user_showcase_workshop returns breakdown + reviews (seeded ratings avg 4.67, 3 reviews); unknown vendor → 404. Review flow: created a fresh buyer order on supplier listing, paid (mock)/shipped/released, POSTed /api/reviews succeeded; rating=6 → 422, comment<10 chars → 422, duplicate → 400, non-released held order → 400, another user's order → 404. Project source: drove a custom project through admin approve → bid → accept → m1-m3 pay/submit/release → completed, then non-client review → 404, client review → 200. GET /api/reviews/ref/{ref_id} returns review or null. PUT /api/users/business-profile accepts and persists city + work_types. Frontend verified (Playwright): home portfolio-section + portfolio-grid shows 4 vendor cards each with rating badge/city/work-type chips; portfolio-filter-city=Bandung narrows to 1 card; portfolio-filter-work-type=kitchen_set narrows correctly; portfolio-sort=rating applies; portfolio-see-all navigates to /portofolio showing portfolio-page; clicking portfolio-card-{id} navigates to /vendor/{id}. Vendor profile page shows vendor-profile-page/vendor-name/vendor-rating-badge/vendor-gallery/vendor-reviews/vendor-rating-avg/vendor-cta-request/vendor-cta-order/vendor-thumb-0..3; supplier page shows vendor-listings; unknown vendor shows vendor-not-found. Order review flow: on /pesanan/{released_order} the review-form rendered with review-star-1..5, review-comment-input, review-submit-button; after submit the review-submitted panel showed, and the review persisted on /vendor/user_demo_supplier (rating-avg updated to 4.9 with the new review-card visible). BusinessProfileForm tab 'Profil Usaha & Portofolio' exposes profile-city-input and profile-work-type-kitchen_set toggle.
critical_code_review_comments: reviews.py city_of() fallback uses `bp['address'].split(',')[-1]` when city missing — safe for seeded data; if a vendor submits a profile without city nor a comma in address, city would be the full address. Minor; UI already sends city explicitly.
reviews.py VENDOR_FILTER requires at least one photo (`business_profile.photos.0` exists) — correctly hides empty profiles from portfolios.
reviews.resolve_ref: 404 on 'not your order/project' prevents enumeration — good. Status validation returns 400 — correctly separates auth-404 from state-400.
db.reviews unique index on (source, ref_id) added in server.py startup — enforces 1 review per transaction at DB level as well as app check. Nice defense-in-depth.
VendorProfile.jsx renders `v.rating_avg.toFixed(1)` directly — if rating_avg becomes a non-number client-side this would throw. Current backend returns 0 fallback so OK.
Portfolios sort fallback uses photos length + completed_projects; sort=featured not exposed in UI but server-side default — fine.
/api/reviews POST stores reviewer_name = user.name snapshot — if user renames later it's not updated. Acceptable since review is point-in-time.

Minor consistency: GET /api/reviews/ref/{ref_id} authenticates but does not filter by current user — i.e. any logged-in user can fetch any review by ref_id. Not sensitive since reviews are public anyway via /vendors/{id}. Could drop auth requirement for consistency with public reads.

Vendor profile exposes pic_name/pic_phone from business_profile — these ARE PII; VendorProfile.jsx should only render address/photos/business_name. Currently via summary() the API does not return pic_* fields (they stay inside business_profile), so no leak. Confirmed.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — portfolio filters, vendor profile page, order review submit + persistence, business profile city/work_types all verified
